name: webmagic
description: WebMagic — a browser MMO dungeon crawler in the style of classic first-person shooters

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @webmagic/server" "npm run dev -w @webmagic/client"
scripts.start: npm run build -w @webmagic/client && npm run start -w @webmagic/server
